title: Domestic Trade Credit Insurance - Standard
description: Comprehensive protection against bad debts from domestic buyers with coverage up to 90% of invoice value.
coverage: Protection against buyer insolvency and protracted default
Coverage up to 90% of insured debt
Buyer credit assessment and monitoring
Claims support and collection assistance
exclusions: Disputes over quality or delivery of goods
Contractual penalties or late payment fees

requirements: Minimum annual turnover of INR 10 million
Business must be registered for at least 2 years

title: Domestic Trade Credit Insurance - Premium
description: Enhanced domestic coverage with higher limits (95%) and additional risk management services.
coverage: Coverage up to 95% of insured debts
Advanced risk analytics and portfolio monitoring
Dedicated account management
Expedited claims processing
Extended payment terms coverage
exclusions: Losses from buyers with known credit issues

requirements: Minimum annual turnover of INR 50 million
Business must be registered for at least 3 years

title: Export Trade Credit Insurance - Basic
description: Fundamental protection for export transactions covering commercial and political risks.
coverage: Commercial risk coverage (buyer insolvency, protracted default)
Political risk coverage (currency inconvertibility, transfer restrictions)
War and civil disturbance protection
Coverage up to 85% of insured value
exclusions: Currency fluctuations outside political risk events

requirements: Minimum annual export turnover of INR 5 million
Buyer information and credit history required

title: Export Trade Credit Insurance - Comprehensive
description: Full-spectrum export coverage with 90% limit and extended political risk protection.
coverage: All major political and commercial risks
Currency fluctuation coverage
Contract frustration protection
Import license cancellation coverage
Coverage up to 90% with flexible premium options
Global buyer intelligence and market entry support

requirements: Minimum annual export turnover of INR 20 million

title: Export Trade Credit Insurance - High-Risk Markets
description: Specialized coverage for exports to high-risk geographic regions with enhanced political risk protection.
coverage: Enhanced political risk coverage including expropriation
Political violence and civil disturbance protection
Sovereign default coverage
Coverage up to 85% with risk-based pricing
Country risk reports and mitigation strategies
exclusions: Losses from countries under comprehensive sanctions

requirements: Specialized export experience in target markets
Minimum annual export turnover of INR 15 million
Enhanced due diligence on buyers required

title: Single Buyer Insurance - Domestic
description: Targeted coverage for a specific domestic buyer relationship with flexible terms.
coverage: Coverage for one specific domestic buyer
Coverage up to 90% of insured exposure
Customizable policy terms
Buyer financial monitoring and early warning alerts
exclusions: Losses from other buyers not specified in policy
Known credit issues with the buyer at policy inception

requirements: Buyer must have a credit rating assessment

title: Single Buyer Insurance - Export
description: Focused protection for a specific export buyer with commercial and political risk coverage.
coverage: Commercial and political risk coverage for one international buyer
Coverage up to 85% with policy duration matching contract terms
Buyer country risk assessment
Political risk monitoring

title: Single Buyer Insurance - Project-Based
description: Project-specific coverage for long-term contracts with milestone-based protection.
coverage: Coverage adjusts based on project completion stages
Contract frustration coverage
Performance bond protection
Milestone-based claim settlement
exclusions: Project delays not caused by credit events

requirements: Contract must specify payment terms linked to milestones

title: Whole Turnover Insurance - Domestic

Automated underwriting with real-time risk assessment
Coverage up to 90% with volume-based premium discounts
Portfolio management dashboard
Ongoing buyer monitoring

requirements: Minimum annual domestic turnover of INR 25 million
Diverse customer base (no single buyer > 30% of turnover)

title: Whole Turnover Insurance - Export
description: Comprehensive coverage for all export transactions with global risk management.
coverage: Coverage for all international sales
Global buyer database with continuous monitoring
Coverage up to 85% with multi-currency support
Political risk protection
Country-specific limits

description: Combined domestic and export coverage with unified policy management.
coverage: Coverage for both domestic and export sales under one policy
Flexible coverage limits per region (90% domestic, 85% export)
Integrated risk management platform
Global buyer insights
Optimized premium structure for mixed trade portfolios
exclusions: Exclusions apply separately for domestic and export
High-risk countries and buyers as per policy terms

title: Single Buyer Insurance - Government

coverage: Enhanced sovereign risk coverage including budgetary constraints

Regulatory change protection
Contract cancellation coverage

requirements: Contract value and payment terms documented

description: Simplified domestic coverage for small businesses with streamlined underwriting.

Quick turnaround for policy issuance
